messages.task:
You are a financial-analysis assistant.  Use the information contained in the following scenario and the tools available to you to determine the requested value.  When you need specific figures (for example, individual asset amounts) you should obtain them by invoking the tools rather than assuming them.

Scenario (context only – detailed numerical table not shown):
notes to consolidated financial statements 2014 (continued) owns the remaining 44% (44%).  We purchased our share of GPAP Philippines for $10.9 million.  The purpose of this acquisition was to expand our presence in the Asia-Pacific market.  This business acquisition was not significant to our consolidated financial statements and accordingly, we have not provided pro-forma information relating to this acquisition.  All of the goodwill associated with the acquisition is non-deductible for tax purposes.  The customer-related intangible assets have amortisation periods of 11 years.  The contract-based intangible assets have amortisation periods of 7 years.  The trademark has an amortisation period of 5 years.

Money transfer branch locations: during 2009, we completed the second and final series of money-transfer branch-location acquisitions in the United States as part of an assignment and asset-purchase agreement with a privately held company.  The purpose of this acquisition was to increase the market presence of our Dolex-branded money-transfer offering.  Pursuant to our annual impairment test in fiscal 2009, goodwill and other intangibles related to our money-transfer business were deemed impaired.

Fiscal 2008 Discover: during the year ended May 31, 2008 we acquired a portfolio of merchants that process Discover transactions and the rights to process Discover transactions for our existing and new merchants.  The purchase of the portfolio was structured to occur in tranches.  As a result of this acquisition, we now process Discover transactions similarly to how we currently process Visa and Mastercard transactions.  The customer-related intangible assets have amortisation periods of 10 years.

(Only a high-level narrative is shown here; detailed numerical allocations are stored in the database and must be retrieved via tools.)

Available tools:
• list_acquisitions() → list[str]
  Returns the names of all recorded acquisitions.

• get_acquisition_region(acquisition_name: str) → str
  Gives the geographical region for the specified acquisition.

• get_asset_breakdown(acquisition_name: str) → dict[str, float]
  Provides a mapping of every asset line item to its amount for the chosen acquisition.

• get_assets_by_category(acquisition_name: str, category_name: str) → dict[str, float]
  Returns only the asset lines whose category matches the supplied name (for instance "Tangible" or "Intangible").

• get_total_amount(asset_amount_mapping: dict[str, float]) → float
  Utility that sums the values in a mapping produced by another tool.

• get_tangible_asset_value(acquisition_name: str) → float
  Convenience wrapper that already aggregates all tangible assets for the requested acquisition.

• get_total_assets_value(acquisition_name: str) → float
  Retrieves the amount recorded under the line item "total assets acquired" for the acquisition.

Question:
What percent of the assets purchased in the acquisition are tangible?

Respond with the single numeric percentage value followed by a percent sign (e.g., "17.4%"), with no additional commentary.
